note: The compact set, written 2026-09-15. Three decisions only the founders can take, five facts only they know, and every other card taken on its own recommendation with the reason on the card. A taken card re-opens when an answer it assumed changes; deps lists what each one assumes, as [card or decision, the answer assumed].

decisions.title: What it is
decisions.q: What is frontmatter, in one sentence?

options.label: A markdown editor, with a document kit as the way in
options.what: The 13 September plan. Review state, attribution, the engine and the certificate become later work.

options.label: Where you write, review and keep current the files your agents obey
options.what: The 14 September set. An editor scoped to AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and rules files, with the kit as the way in and review state on those files.

options.label: The engine and the review state, shipped inside an editor
options.what: Byte-exact writes and who read what as the product, on any markdown. The four free diff panels compete with this directly.

options.label: A markdown editor, plainly
options.what: Compete on editing. Seven free self-hosted editors with 21,501 to 76,040 stars are the comparison.

decisions.why: Option b is the only sentence here that names a job nobody else does. Over 60,000 projects carry an AGENTS.md, one file in openai/codex has taken 77 commits, and two LibreChat files have drifted apart three times. Spec Kit and Kiro generate the files and leave. Options a and d put the product on the free-editor shelf, where the price is zero. Option c is the shape four platforms shipped free in nine weeks, and the shape Almanac shut down with.
decisions.evidence: The AGENTS.md count, the openai/codex commits and the LibreChat drift are on F35 and P2. Almanac and the four free panels are on MK27 and P2.

decisions.title: Which bytes we hold
decisions.q: Which document bytes do we ever hold on our servers, and from which phase?

options.label: None, in any phase
options.what: The zero-bytes rule as L1 states it, kept forever. No kit link, no shared link, no Pro storage or sync.

options.label: None in Phase 0; kits and Pro documents from Phase 1, under section 8's rules
options.what: Delete the Firestore design now and ship Phase 0 holding nothing. When the kit link and Pro ship, hold only those, built new under the rules in section 8 of the MVP plan, and record the reversal.

options.label: Kits only, never documents
options.what: The funnel holds. Pro sells no storage, sync or share link, so the Pro row shrinks to the key, templates and the kit.

options.label: Documents from day one, the Firestore design as written
options.what: Hosted sync, search and publishing from the start, with intermediary status and the ₹250 crore ceiling before the first stranger.

decisions.why: The MVP plan reverses the zero-bytes rule for kits and Pro documents, and L1 keeps the rule. Both are on record. The kit link, Pro's storage and sync, and read-and-comment sharing all need bytes held somewhere. Option b is the only one that keeps the Phase 0 claim exact, keeps the funnel, and takes the intermediary duty only once a paying document exists to justify it. Option a kills the funnel. Option d takes a ₹250 crore ceiling and 74 founder-hours of duty before a single user exists. Option c leaves Pro with nothing the category pays for.
decisions.evidence: The ceiling and the 74 founder-hours are on L1. The Pro row is on PR24 and PR1. The kit link is on F34. The reversal is section 8 of the MVP plan.

decisions.title: The name
decisions.q: Do we keep the word frontmatter, qualify it, coin a name, or make MDMAX the brand?

options.label: Keep Frontmatter bare
options.what: No teaching cost. The one configuration all three naming reports argue against, in the store the buyer uses.

options.label: Qualify the spoken name, and not with CMS or Studio
options.what: A copy change, not a rename. Both best qualifiers are taken, and a disambiguation sentence follows every conversation.

options.label: Coin a name; keep frontmatter as the word for the block we edit
options.what: Kills the collision and the search problem. One sentence of teaching per asset, and 169 strings to rename now.

options.label: Flip the hierarchy: MDMAX becomes the brand
options.what: No new clearance and it settles the two-names question. Reads as a library name, and md reads as a medical degree.

decisions.why: Front Matter CMS has 82,265 installs in the VS Code store, shipped v10.12.0 on 21 August 2026, and owns the @frontmatter npm scope. Somebody else registered Frontmatter Studio on 7 September. Both same-market precedents on record ended in a rename, Firefox twice while small and Riot.im after launch. Coining now costs 169 strings; coining later costs a migration. This is the one decision I would not take for you. The name goes on every screen and export, and the register reads in N3 come before it freezes.
decisions.evidence: The install count, the scope and the precedents are on N1. The freeze point is N2 and the register reads are N3.

facts.title: Facts only you know
facts.note: Not decisions. Every date, price and legal clock in the plan is denominated in these five, and no research can answer them. Answer them as cards.
